integrity: The explicit finite formulas, collision bounds and L2 estimate are proved in RESULT.md and checked on finite digraphs by checker.py. An inaccessible related full paper remains a novelty risk; no independence or historical priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive c and independent loopless arcs with probability \(c/n\). Local validity quantifies over every propositional valuation; no result for global validity, reflexive edges, undirected dependence, or growing c. Finite error is an upper bound, not an exact exception law.
title: Four-profile law for local modal validity in sparse directed frames
